reviews.author: Jinwoo Park
reviews.text:
I am a student who visited the sky bowling alley.
I stopped by a bowling alley to go bowling with my friends for the first time in a while, so we bought two games and the owner told us not to avoid the seats next to him, but rather went to the side and played, and changed our seats. He told us as if we were not customers, which was very unpleasant. However, we had no choice but to go to the next seat and try to bowl, but the wall was protruding, so we couldn't hit it properly. So, we tried to go to another spot, but it was all crowded, so we told the owner that it was uncomfortable because the wall was protruding, and asked him to give us a refund. But he said, “No, you already played it once.” I asked, “Then can you give me half price?” and the owner said, “Why didn’t you guys play it and did it to me?” I came here for the first time today, and I’m disappointed.

reviews.author: BONG
reviews.text:
A bowling alley that appears to have been recently opened.
As I was passing by after eating, I suddenly went in and was surprised to see that it was a pretty hot, clean, and nice bowling alley.
Actually, I only went in after looking at the event price, but it was an event with a set time and day, and I decided to play a few games while I was in.

The conversation fee (shoe rental) was 2,000 won per person, and playing 2 games for 2 people cost about 26,000 won, so it doesn't seem like a very expensive price.

There were quite a few customers, mainly students and teenagers, and at the far end, there were quite a few talented people, perhaps from the athlete class.

In fact, perhaps because there were a lot of young people, the game manners were not at the level I expected, but it was a bit disappointing that the space between lanes overlapped too much and were too close together.

The balls and pins were all in good condition, and although the atmosphere was dark, the neon lights were quite hot.

The facilities were clean and the restrooms were kept clean.
